facts.fact: The State Information Technology Agency (SITA), a government-owned organisation, provides IT services to public sector bodies and runs Home Affairs on IBM System Z mainframes.
The Department of Home Affairs says SITA technicians and engineers were attending to a fault on the SITA mainframe that affects access to the National Population Register.

ZAF.note: The SITA data centres are not stated to rent to other organisations; the Tier III upgrade is not in service.

facts.fact: A Home Affairs statement says a SITA mainframe fault affects access to the National Population Register, which Home Affairs services depend on.

systems.owner: Department of Home Affairs; operated by SITA
